title: AI Blog Post Outline Generator
subtitle: Enter a topic, get a structured outline with H2/H3 sections and a meta description in seconds.
resultDisclaimer: This is a starting point. Add your own perspective, examples, and data before publishing.
whatIsText: The hardest part of writing a blog post is deciding what to write about and in what order. This tool reads your topic, the keywords you want to rank for, and your target audience, then produces a structured outline — H2 and H3 sections with bullet points under each one, plus a suggested meta description. Paste it into Google Docs, Notion, or your CMS and start writing.
howToUseTitle: How to get the best outlines
tip1: Be specific in the topic. "How to start a podcast for beginners" produces a better outline than "podcasts."
tip2: Include 1-3 target keywords. The model will weave them into H2 and H3 titles where they fit naturally.
tip3: Describe your audience. "Small business owners who've never blogged" produces different structure and tone than "experienced developers."
tip4: Use Detailed for pillar content. Long-form guides benefit from 7-9 sections. Use Brief for weekly posts or short updates.
faq1a: Yes. It runs on Cloudflare Workers AI with a free daily quota. Normal use won't hit limits.
faq2q: Will this write the whole article for me?
faq2a: No, and that's intentional. This tool produces an outline, not the article. Writing the actual content is where your unique perspective matters most. The outline gives you a structure to fill in.
faq3a: Partially. The tool weaves your target keywords into section titles where they fit naturally, and generates a meta description. But real SEO requires backlinks, topical depth, and content that satisfies search intent — the outline is just the starting point.
faq4q: Can I use this for YouTube scripts?
faq4a: Yes. The structure works well for video scripts — each H2 becomes a major segment, each H3 a talking point. You may want to ignore the meta description section for video content.
faq5a: No. Your topic, keywords, and audience description are sent to the AI model for processing and discarded immediately after. Nothing is stored, logged, or used for training.
disclaimer: Note: Always review and adapt the outline. AI doesn't know your audience or your unique angle — you do.
footer: Runs on Cloudflare Workers AI. Your text is not stored.
